1: // Simple Asteroid Dodge game
2: // Canvas with id="game" assumed in HTML
3: (() => {
4:   const canvas = document.getElementById('game');
5:   if (!canvas) return;
6:   const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
7:   const width = canvas.width = canvas.clientWidth;
8:   const height = canvas.height = canvas.clientHeight;
9:   // Audio context and sound helpers
10:   const audioCtx = new (window.AudioContext || window.webkitAudioContext)();
11:   function playThrust(){
12:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
13:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
14:     osc.frequency.value = 400;
15:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, audioCtx.currentTime);
16:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
17:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
18:     osc.start();
19:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.1);
20:   }
21:   function playExplosion(){
22:     const osc = audioCtx.createOscillator();
23:     const gain = audioCtx.createGain();
24:     osc.frequency.value = 100;
25:     gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.5, audioCtx.currentTime);
26:     gain.gain.exponentialRampToValueAtTime(0.001, audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
27:     osc.connect(gain).connect(audioCtx.destination);
28:     osc.start();
29:     osc.stop(audioCtx.currentTime + 0.5);
30:   }
31:   // Ship definition
32:   const ship = {
33:     x: 50,
34:     y: height / 2,
35:     w: 30,
36:     h: 30,
37:     vy: 0,
38:     gravity: 0.4,
39:     thrust: -8,
40:     color: '#0f0'
41:   };
42: 
43: 
44:   // Asteroid pool
45:   const asteroids = [];
46:   // Star field for background
47:   const stars = [];
48:   for (let i = 0; i < 100; i++) {
49:     stars.push({
50:       x: Math.random() * width,
51:       y: Math.random() * height,
52:       r: Math.random() * 1.5 + 0.5
53:     });
54:   }
55:   const asteroidSpawnInterval = 1500; // ms
56:   let lastSpawn = 0;
57:   const asteroidSpeed = 4;
58: 
59:   let score = 0;
60: 
61:   // Input handling – click or tap anywhere
62:   const thrustShip = () => { ship.vy = ship.thrust; playThrust(); };
63:   canvas.addEventListener('mousedown', thrustShip);
64:   canvas.addEventListener('touchstart', e => { e.preventDefault(); thrustShip(); });
65: 
66:   // Game loop
67:   function update(dt) {
68:     // Move background stars for parallax effect
69:     // Ship physics
70:     ship.vy += ship.gravity;
71:     ship.y += ship.vy;
72:     // Prevent ship from leaving top
73:     if (ship.y < 0) { ship.y = 0; ship.vy = 0; }
74:     // Bottom lose condition
75:     if (ship.y + ship.h > height) {
76:       gameOver();
77:       return false;
78:     }
79: 
80:     // Asteroid spawning
81:         // Move stars for parallax
82:     stars.forEach(s => {
83:       s.x -= 0.3;
84:       if (s.x < 0) s.x = width;
85:     });
86:     if (performance.now() - lastSpawn > asteroidSpawnInterval) {
87:       spawnAsteroid();
88:       lastSpawn = performance.now();
89:     }
90: 
91:     // Move asteroids
92:     for (let i = asteroids.length - 1; i >= 0; i--) {
93:       const a = asteroids[i];
94:       a.x -= asteroidSpeed;
95:       a.angle += a.angularVel || 0;
96:       // Collision detection (AABB)
97:       if (a.x < ship.x + ship.w && a.x + a.w > ship.x && a.y < ship.y + ship.h && a.y + a.h > ship.y) {
98:         gameOver();
99:         return false;
100:       }
101:       // Remove off-screen asteroids and increase score
102:       if (a.x + a.w < 0) {
103:         asteroids.splice(i, 1);
104:         score++;
105:       }
106:     }
107:     return true;
108:   }
109: 
110:   function render() {
111:     // Background gradient (space)
112:     const bgGrad = ctx.createLinearGradient(0, 0, 0, height);
113:     bgGrad.addColorStop(0, '#02010a');
114:     bgGrad.addColorStop(1, '#09002b');
115:     ctx.fillStyle = bgGrad;
116:     ctx.fillRect(0, 0, width, height);
117:     // Stars (twinkling)
118:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
119:     stars.forEach(s => {
120:       ctx.beginPath();
121:       ctx.arc(s.x, s.y, s.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
122:       ctx.fill();
123:     });
124:     // Draw ship as triangle
125:     ctx.fillStyle = ship.color;
126:     ctx.beginPath();
127:     ctx.moveTo(ship.x, ship.y + ship.h / 2);
128:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y);
129:     ctx.lineTo(ship.x + ship.w, ship.y + ship.h);

132:     // Draw asteroids with radial gradient

139:         0,

143:       grad.addColorStop(0, '#777');
144:       grad.addColorStop(1, '#222');
145:       ctx.save();
146:       ctx.translate(a.x + a.w / 2, a.y + a.h / 2);
147:       ctx.rotate(a.angle || 0);
148:       ctx.fillStyle = grad;
149:       ctx.fillRect(-a.w / 2, -a.h / 2, a.w, a.h);
150:       ctx.restore();
151:     });
152:     // Draw score
153:     ctx.fillStyle = '#fff';
154:     ctx.font = '16px sans-serif';
155:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, 10, 20);
156:   }

158:   let lastTime = 0;
159:   function loop(timestamp) {
160:     const dt = timestamp - lastTime;
161:     lastTime = timestamp;
162:     if (update(dt)) {
163:       render();
164:       requestAnimationFrame(loop);
165:     }
166:   }
167:

169:   const size = Math.random() * 30 + 20;
170:   const yPos = Math.random() * (height - size);
171:   const angle = Math.random() * Math.PI * 2;
172:   const angularVel = (Math.random() - 0.5) * 0.02;
173:   asteroids.push({ x: width, y: yPos, w: size, h: size, angle, angularVel });
174: }

179: 
180:   function gameOver() {
181:   playExplosion();
182:     ctx.fillStyle = 'rgba(0,0,0,0.7)';
183:     ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
184:     ctx.fillStyle = '#f00';
185:     ctx.font = '24px sans-serif';

189:     ctx.fillText('Score: ' + score, width/2 - 40, height/2 + 30);
